positions.name: Semtech Corporation
positions.sector: Semiconductors — Signal Integrity / AI Data-Center Interconnect
positions.catalyst: Semtech reported FQ2-27 after the close Aug 25 and delivered a beat-AND-raise of unusual magnitude that the tape has barely priced. Record net sales $341.9M (+33% y/y, +17% q/q) vs ~$328.6M consensus; adjusted EPS $0.71 vs $0.61 est (+15.6%). The real catalyst is the FQ3 guide: $410M revenue against roughly $360M consensus — a ~$50M / ~14% guidance beat and another ~20% sequential step-up — with adjusted operating margin guided to 31.0%, up ~660bps sequentially. Infrastructure revenue $124M (+69% y/y, +25% q/q) on a record $100M data-center quarter, and CEO Hong Hou explicitly flagged 'accelerating bookings and record backlog' with visibility 'well into next fiscal year.' Premarket $132.85 vs $127.52 prior close = +4.2%, well inside the chase threshold.
positions.driver: The asymmetry is the gap between the size of the guidance revision and the size of the price reaction. A ~14% raise to next-quarter revenue plus 660bps of operating-margin expansion normally re-rates a $12B semi by double digits; SMTC is up 4.2%. It also still trades ~25% below its June 15 52-week high of $177.35, so there is real gap-fill room overhead, and sell-side targets sit far above spot (Roth $190, UBS $225 post-Q1). Company-specific downside is materially de-risked because management has already put FQ3 numbers on the table — the quarter is guided, not guessed. Business mix is the AI data-center interconnect franchise (CopperEdge active copper cables designed into NVIDIA rack-scale systems, 800G FiberEdge and 1.6T optical DSPs, plus a named hyperscaler design win ramping through 2026), which is the fastest-growing part of the AI capex stack. Liquidity is fine for a 100% book: $11.9B market cap, 8.9M shares traded Tuesday vs a 3.3M two-week average. Chose SMTC over the alternatives deliberately: INTU (-11.7%) and ZM (-5.8%) are post-guidance falling knives, SUPN is already +20% on an ALL-STOCK merger of equals with no cash floor and is past the chase threshold, and the rest of the premarket gainer list is sub-$50M micro-cap noise that the mandate bans.
positions.risks: The dominant risk is event overlap, and it is not small. NVIDIA reports FQ2 tonight after the close (consensus ~$2.09 EPS on ~$92.01B revenue) and this book does not flatten intraday — the position is held straight through that print and exits tomorrow morning. SMTC is a high-beta NVIDIA-supply-chain derivative; a light NVDA guide gaps SMTC down overnight and a stop order does not protect against an overnight gap. Second, PCE, core PCE, personal income/spending, July durable goods and the second Q2 GDP estimate all hit at 8:30am ET today, with the 10-year at 4.64% and CME FedWatch pricing a 36.1% chance the Fed HIKES in September — a hot PCE is a direct multiple hit to a 19x-book semi. Third, the stop at $123.55 (-7%) sits just below Tuesday's $124.11 low, so it is a genuine thesis-invalidation level rather than noise, but it also means a full round-trip of the earnings gap takes the position out. Company-specific: SMTC carries a negative trailing P/E (-322) and a 19.6x price/book, there is a reported GaN supply constraint on tunable laser chips, and the muted +4% reaction may itself signal that buy-side expectations were already above the raised guide. Jackson Hole runs Aug 27-29.
